data: Are all three tree structures depicted in Figure 13 oriented vertically, with the top node positioned above the bottom nodes?

The trees shown in Figure 13 are indeed oriented vertically, with the top node positioned above the bottom nodes. The leftmost tree represents negation, the middle tree represents conjunction, and the rightmost tree represents disjunction. Each tree has a single top node connected to two child nodes, which are further connected to their respective leaves. The orientation is consistent across all three trees, confirming that they are all oriented vertically.
